meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Employer-sponsored mental health and wellbeing benefits for the workplace

analysis.summary: Lyra Health is the only rival publishing at scale, with 14 new pages and 11 updates. Spring Health made no new pages in 30 days. It updated 3 old pages.

points.text: Lyra is pushing manager coaching hard, with launch news, a landing page and several guides, all updated or new.
Spring Health's 2 listed pages are consumer-style therapy guides. Lyra aims at employers with research, case studies and a customer spotlight.
Talkspace and TELUS Health added 4 pages each, but on narrow topics. Talkspace targets health plans. TELUS's pages are one Spanish page repeated.

Spring Health.play: No new pages. Updated 2 therapy and anxiety how-tos; 77 pages edited in bulk on 2026-10-16.

Lyra Health.play: Manager coaching push, plus research, case studies, financial wellness and seasonal toolkits, mostly new or refreshed.

Modern Health.play: No new or updated pages found. Has 155 templated /post/ pages.

Calm Business.play: No pages found on the site data. Nothing to read.

Talkspace for Business.play: Four new guides on behavioral healthcare, managed care and women's programs.

TELUS Health (LifeWorks).play: Four new Spanish pages on healthy team habits. Large templated /solutions/ section.

shared.title: Light, narrow publishing
shared.text: Talkspace and TELUS Health each added 4 pages and no updates. Both are small batches on one theme, so this is a weak signal, not a strategy. Spring Health can outpace them.

shared.title: Templated page sections
shared.text: Modern Health (/post/, 155 pages) and TELUS Health (/solutions/, 246 pages) rely on large templated areas. Their size comes from templates, not individual articles.

gaps.title: Employer proof and case studies
gaps.text: Only Lyra shows customer stories (2) and original research (1). Spring Health can publish employer outcome stories for HR buyers.

gaps.title: Manager support content
gaps.text: Lyra is building a manager coaching cluster. Spring Health has nothing listed here, so it can take its own angle on manager burnout.

gaps.title: Vendor comparison guides for buyers
gaps.text: Only Talkspace has one comparison page, aimed at health plans. Nobody covers how HR leaders should evaluate workplace mental health vendors.
